gloss: journey, one's travels, road of travel

definitions.gloss: journey, one's travels, road of travel
definitions.explanation: The course or path of a journey. A literary term that evokes the experience and process of traveling, rather than just the destination.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧{旅路|たびじ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{疲|つか}れた→疲れる：00901_tsukareru⟧。
examples.english: I was tired from the long journey.

examples.japanese: {旅路|たびじ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{途中|とちゅう}→途中：01684_tochuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧⟦{景色|けしき}→景色：01395_keshiki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出会|であ}った→出会う：02298_deau⟧。
examples.english: I encountered beautiful scenery along the way.

examples.japanese: ⟦{人生|じんせい}→人生：03355_jinsei⟧⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧{旅路|たびじ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{出会|であ}い→出会う：02298_deau⟧、⟦{別|わか}れて→別れる：01113_wakareru⟧きた。
examples.english: Along the journey of life, I have met and parted with many people.

notes:
USAGE:
A literary and poetic word. Often used figuratively for the journey of life (⟦{人生|じんせい}→人生：03355_jinsei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{旅路|たびじ}). Less common in everyday speech than ⟦{旅|たび}→旅：03407_tabi⟧ or ⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧. Frequently appears in literature, poetry, and song lyrics.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧{旅路|たびじ}: long journey
- {旅路|たびじ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{途中|とちゅう}→途中：01684_tochuu⟧: on the way, mid-journey
- ⟦{人生|じんせい}→人生：03355_jinsei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{旅路|たびじ}: the journey of life
- {旅路|たびじ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{就|つ}く→就く：10123_tsuku⟧: to set out on a journey

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{旅|たび}→旅：03407_tabi⟧: trip, travel (common, everyday)
- ⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧: trip, travel (practical, neutral)
- ⟦{道中|どうちゅう}→道中：14427_douchuu⟧: en route, along the way
